name: plaid-money-summary
description: Combines the outputs of several `plaid-bank-digest` nodes (joined by a Collect node) into one money summary. Pure computation: no network, no memory, no clock. Returns `cash`, `owed_on_cards` and `cash_after_cards` across all banks; `spending` with last week's day-to-day and fixed totals, the usual week (the median of the earlier weeks, so one unusual week does not move it), a monthly average, `months_of_cash`, the top categories beside their own usual week and the largest items; and `recurring` monthly charges with the new ones. A figure that rests on a bank that could not be read is `null` rather than a partial sum: `cash` and `months_of_cash` need every bank, while spending from the banks that were read is still given with `partial: true`. Banks that failed upstream are listed under `missing` with the reason the engine recorded. Weeks before a bank's history begins are not counted as weeks of zero spending, and no usual week is stated from fewer than four earlier weeks.

BANKS.description: The banks expected, by the INSTITUTION given to each plaid-bank-digest node. A bank listed here that produced no digest is reported under `missing`, and the totals that need it are null.
